mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the next 20 days signals an easing monetary policy cycle, lowering future discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the next 20 days, or the decline is not sustained (e.g., short-term fluctuations).

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL crosses above 250 in the next 20 days, it signals rising inflation expectations prompting the Fed to maintain tight policy, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 250 in the next 20 days
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 250, or the inflation spike is transitory (e.g., due to one-time energy price spikes).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and decline in UNRATE over the next 20 days indicates conflicting signals: monetary tightening and labor market strength, creating market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises AND UNRATE falls over the next 20 days
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive when both FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or the labor market strength is weak despite rising rates.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the next 20 days amplifies market optimism about future rate cuts, leading to stronger positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS declines, or the decline is not sustained (e.g., short-term dip).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in UNRATE over the next 5 days indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative despite UNRATE rising, or the labor market strength is weak (e.g., rising rates offset gains).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO over the next 60 days signals stronger industrial production, enhancing economic momentum and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when INDPRO rises, or the supply boost is temporary (e.g., seasonal factors).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly rise in GDPC1 over the next 5 days indicates expanding economic activity, boosting corporate profits and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Returns are negative despite GDPC1 growth, or the GDP growth is not sustained (e.g., one-time stimulus).

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS crosses above 1.5 million in the next 60 days, it signals robust job growth, stimulating consumer demand and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 1.5 million in the next 60 days
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative despite PAYEMS crossing above 1.5M, or the job growth is not sustained (e.g., temporary hiring).
